messages:
mina (Docs): quick flag: /v2/jobs/submit API ref response example lists `outputs` as an object `{label: value}` but the service returns an array of output objects. TS quickstart expecting object fails at runtime.

jorge (API): thanks. which page/line?

mina (Docs): openapi response example near `200` block: https://redwood.dev/api-ref#/jobs/submit. shows `outputs: { transcript: '...' }`. real payload: `outputs: [{ name: 'transcript', text: '...' }, { name: 'summary', text: '...' }]`.

anya (SDK): that mismatch explains the SDK bug I opened yesterday. our client maps `resp.outputs` to a Record<string,string> causing TS errors and dropped outputs.

jorge (API): looks like docs kept an older simplified example. runtime always returned an array since we added multi-output routing last quarter. my bad.

mina (Docs): propose: update openapi example to an array-of-objects sample, fix the JS/TS snippets to iterate outputs, and add a short migration note: "outputs changed shape to an array of objects for multi-output models".

anya (SDK): i'll update the SDK to accept both shapes for one release cycle and normalize to array-of-objects. PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/195. will add unit tests and update quickstart snippet in SDK repo.

jorge (API): optional: we can add a compatibility layer in API to accept old clients returning object, but since this is docs-only (runtime is array), not necessary. i will, however, change the openapi generator so it uses the current response schema not the legacy template. PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/1044

tess (Support): flagged a customer who integrated the example and shipped code that broke parsing. can we add a note in the changelog and ping support so they can advise customers?

mina (Docs): yes adding changelog note and support ping. PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/449 (updates example, snippets, migration note, and changelog entry). aiming for docs deploy tomorrow morning.

anya (SDK): merged SDK PR to main and published canary 0.13.1-canary.2. quickstart updated. included a deprecation log when normalization happens.

docbot: docs deploy scheduled by mina for 2026-03-25T09:00:00-07:00 :calendar:

mina (Docs): merged docs PR and verified the new example renders correctly and the quickstart iterates outputs in the sample.

docbot: docs deploy successful (v2026-03-25-0900) :white_check_mark: live on staging.

jorge (API): updated internal spec generator to prefer the array schema and removed the legacy example template.

mina (Docs): added a short FAQ entry: "Why are outputs an array?" explaining multi-output models and a snippet showing how to map to a name->value object if desired. pinging #support with link.

any follow-ups?

anya (SDK): i'll follow up with a small patch next week to drop the temporary object-accepting code after one release cycle.

mina (Docs): closing out. thanks team! :sparkles:
